kind: Confirmed URL consistency issue; search impact not causally proven
issue: Public navigation versions HTML URLs using pv while canonical and sitemap use clean URLs
evidence: static-audit.json:5186 parameterized internal links across296 pages
browser-live.json:six clean service navigations acquired pv
recommendation: Keep stable public HTML links; keep asset content hashes and required case return/state parameters. Preserve old incoming version URLs and case return behavior. Do not robots-block parameter variants or remove project/from/return/q/category wholesale.
acceptance: Clean service entry stays clean; normal content links and language switching point to clean canonical paths; assets remain versioned; case return and gallery state pass; no duplicate indexing submissions

kind: Confirmed evidence gap; not proof the underlying service fails
issue: Knowledge-base page proposes answers with sources, but P36 public record only supports duties and initial UI, not answer quality
evidence: cases__p36.html.txt:回答质量与检索效果需要对应问答和检索记录支持

kind: Buyer-decision information gap, not a technical indexing error
issue: AI implementation service publishes a CNY500 floor without a concrete unit or example of what that floor covers
evidence: services__fde-consulting.html.txt:实施服务低至500元起，具体范围和费用在开始前确认
Service page lists tool subscriptions, development, training and maintenance as separately agreed

kind: Editorial focus judgment, not proven keyword cannibalization
issue: Inventory service page also devotes a full section and a case to product copy/image work
recommendation: Keep inventory and repeated entry as the main subject; shorten or move content-workflow material to a supplementary reference to existing content case/home section. No new near-duplicate service pages needed.
